audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart read Aatrox for rows 0-3, Skill at 6. Packet chart is Aatrox/Aatrox/Skill/Skill/Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir and the audited mirror states Level 6 reads Aatrox.
audit.why: Rows 2-3 are skill rows once Sanguine Pool is online to answer the Q3 sweetspot; level 6 belongs to Aatrox because World Ender's AD and healing outlast one 28s pool.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 and 3 flip to Skill, row 4 flips to Aatrox, in matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named no cooldowns and invented a duration-free 'revive potential' framing.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice actionable: Darkin Blade 14/12/10/8/6, Umbral Dash 9/8/7/6/5, Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16, Hemoplague 120.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into spikes[0], spikes[1], breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Hunter of Souls' is not an Aatrox ability — his passive is Deathbringer Stance. His E was only ever called 'E-dash', never Umbral Dash.
audit.why: Fabricated and unnamed abilities are exactly the calibration errors this audit exists to kill; Deathbringer Stance is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash named; Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetability stated as the answer to the Q3 knock-up plus dash follow-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed only in the item section, not tied to which abilities heal him.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender all heal — Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal written into mid and into the low-health don't.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: World Ender swings 6: his AD and healing spike while Hemoplague is a 120s cooldown. Pool his Q3 and refuse the extended trade.

edits.before: Level 6 is a coin-flip — his World Ender all-in is answered by a well-timed Pool.
edits.after: Level 6 favours him — World Ender's AD and healing outlast one 28s Sanguine Pool.

edits.before: Aatrox is at his scariest here: with all three Q casts and Hunter of Souls healing, he wants to catch you inside a Q3 edge and E-dash onto you while your Sanguine Pool is on a long cooldown.
edits.after: Aatrox is at his scariest here: three Q casts plus Deathbringer Stance healing, and he wants to catch you in the Q3 edge and Umbral Dash onto you while Sanguine Pool sits on its 22s cooldown.

edits.before: World Ender turns his Qs into massive burst and revive potential; don't Pool early and get bled out, save it to dodge the final Q3 sweet-spot that would otherwise chunk you for half your bar.
edits.after: World Ender adds AD, healing and move speed; don't spend Sanguine Pool (W) early — save its 2s untargetability for the Q3 sweet-spot, the knock-up that sets up his Umbral Dash follow-up.

edits.before: Aatrox out-ranges and out-sustains you at levels 1-2: his Q edge hits harder than a single Transfusion and Deathbringer Stance heals him through your poke, so give ground and only Q when he whiffs.
edits.after: Aatrox out-ranges and out-sustains you at levels 1-2: his Q edge hits harder than a single Transfusion and Deathbringer Stance heals him through your poke, so give ground and Q him inside his 14s Q gap.

edits.before: Through 3-6 he keeps the initiative with three Q casts and World Ender, but this is Skill: respect the Q3 sweet-spot, Pool only for his E-dash, and don't burn cooldowns feeding his healing.
edits.after: Through 3-6 he keeps initiative with three Q casts and World Ender: respect the Q3 sweet-spot, save Sanguine Pool for Umbral Dash, and buy anti-heal early — his P, E and R all heal him.

edits.before: Save Sanguine Pool for his E-dash all-in, not for poke
edits.after: Save Sanguine Pool for his Umbral Dash all-in, not for poke

edits.before: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: matchup-defining — Sweetspots knock up. Pool/dodge them. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — only the third cast knocks up, so step off the sweetspot or pool it. - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip. - Hemoplague: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Pooling to dodge poke — the pool is your KA answer and your only escape; spending it on chip is fatal.
edits.after: His R raises his healing on top of Deathbringer Stance — fight him low only with Grievous Wounds bought and Pool up.

notes: Fabricated ability name 'Hunter of Souls' removed (Aatrox passive is Deathbringer Stance) — worth a file-wide grep for it across other Vladimir matchups. Mirror's warning about 'Sanguine Pool (E)' did not appear in this matchup's text but Pool was repeatedly left unslotted. wants.foe[0] still says 'follow with E'; renaming to Umbral Dash exceeds the +10% band on a 55-char string, so left alone.
